eps.t: Noggin the King
eps.d: Noggin was a good king. He liked to look after his people. He liked to give them warm socks to wear. He liked to give them good food to eat. He liked to make sure that they had good roofs on their houses. Noggin is happy being king of his people, but one day he decides he would like to be king of the birds as well. Will Noggin be crowned king of the birds?

eps.t: Noggin and the Whale
eps.d: It's Noggin's birthday and he has given musical instruments to all the little children and taken them on a boat trip. Now, there's a whale in the harbour and he won't let them play their music! Can Noggin find out what the whale wants?

eps.t: Noggin and the Dragon
eps.d: Noggin's son, Little Knut, wants to go on a dragon hunt with his friends. So Noggin sends them off with brave Thor Nogson as an escort. But what happens when Thor Nogson finds a dragon? And is the dragon all that it seems?

eps.t: Nogbad comes Back!
eps.d: Noggin's wicked uncle, Nogbad the Bad, has returned from exile to enter the famous animal and vegetable show. But has he really learned how to be good?

eps.t: Noggin and the Moon Mouse
eps.d: A visitor has come to the Land of Nog, but how will Noggin and Nooka persuade everyone that a little mouse is nothing to be afraid of?

eps.t: Nogbad and the Elephants
eps.d: Noggin is trying to cheer up a sad elephant, but Nogbad is plotting to steal it! Will his evil plan work?

eps.t: Noggin and the Money
eps.d: When Olaf the Lofty invents money it seems like a very clever idea. But is money more trouble than it's worth?

eps.t: Noggin and the Storks
eps.d: Storks are nesting on the Nogs' chimneys, filling their houses with smoke! Will Noggin find a way to stop those pesky storks?

eps.t: Noggin the Nog - the King
eps.d: In the lands of the north where the black rocks stand guard against the cold sea.... the men of the Northlands sit by their great log fires and they tell a tale... So began the Sagas of Noggin the Nog, rich, strange tales of Noggin, King of the Nogs and his wicked uncle Nogbad the Bad.......

eps.t: Noggin and the Ice Dragon - The Little Man
eps.d: In which a message is brought to Noggin the Nog from his people in the Far North.

eps.t: Noggin and the Ice Dragon - The Journey
eps.d: In which an expedition is made ready and a strange journey begins.

eps.t: Noggin and the Ice Dragon - The Hot Water Valley
eps.d: In which the birds solve a problem, a dragon is seen, tea is taken, and a small hill climbed.

eps.t: Noggin and the Ice Dragon - The Dragon
eps.d: In which the dragon is coldly encountered, the Nogs fly again, and Thor Nogson ventures into a cave.

eps.t: Noggin and the Ice Dragon - The Treasure
eps.d: In which evil is disclosed but not overcome and a cannon is fired.

eps.t: Noggin and the Ice Dragon - Nogbad the Bad
eps.d: In which a robber is chased and caught, a lullaby is sung, and the story ends.

eps.t: Noggin and the Flying Machine - The Jar
eps.d: Olaf and Graculas invent a flying machine, and a large seated jar floats into the harbour of the Northlands. Who knows where it came from or what it contains?

eps.t: Noggin and the Flying Machine - The Visitor
eps.d: A visitor brings Noggin a useful gift -a gift which turns out to be more useful to him than to Noggin.

eps.t: Noggin and the Flying Machine - The Birds
eps.d: The feathered flying machine rises again. Magic is matched against magic, and in the sky a duel is fought to bring justice to a sad land.

eps.t: Noggin and the Flying Machine - The Land Of Silver Sand
eps.d: The Nogs are welcomed with magic, but not all magic is bad magic.

eps.t: Noggin and the Flying Machine - The City
eps.d: There are secret ways in the great city, places to watch and listen and be discovered.

eps.t: Noggin and the Flying Machine - Come Dragons!
eps.d: Noggin plays his last trick and the champions do battle.

eps.t: Noggin and the Ormuds - The Great Invention
eps.d: How Noggin and Olaf the Lofty meet Groont, an Omrud and Court Inventor to the King-under-the-Hill.

eps.t: Noggin and the Omruds - The Fire Machine
eps.d: How Olaf the Lofty used the invention of the Omruds to make a wondrous machine and what befell it.

eps.t: Noggin and the Omruds - Under The Hill
eps.d: How the Omruds cared for Olaf the Lofty in their home under the hill and what happened to Olaf's invention.

eps.t: Noggin and the Omruds - The Caves of Nudrug
eps.d: How a black crow stole the liquid that made things grow and what happened to Graculus in the caves of Nudrug.

eps.t: Noggin and the Omruds - The Challenge
eps.d: How Noggin rescued his Queen and how a Pretender came to challenge for the Crown of the Northlands.

eps.t: Noggin and the Omruds - The Battle
eps.d: How the large and the small were made equal. Where a battle was fought and how the Omruds came into their garden.

eps.t: Noggin and the Firecake - The Crown Of Flowers
eps.d: Noggin's small son Knut goes with Noggin to watch a demonstration of Olaf the Lofty's latest invention. The demonstration ends with a loud explosion - which leads to a strange adventure.

eps.t: Noggin and the Firecake - Knut's Friend
eps.d: Noggin asks his inventor, Olaf the Lofty, to remove the great stone which has mysteriously appeared outside his palace, but to everyone's surprise the stone disappears as strangely as it came - and brings disaster.

eps.t: Noggin and the Firecake - The Dream
eps.d: Noggin's son, Knut, has a strange dream and Olaf's invention falls into bad hands.

eps.t: Noggin and the Firecake - Nogbad The Bad
eps.d: Noggin's old enemy Nogbad the Bad threatens the kingdom with Olaf's dangerous invention.

eps.t: Noggin and the Firecake - The Sorcerer's Sword
eps.d: Noggin's son, Knut, falls into the power of Nogbad the Bad when the stone giants take him to Roundhead Valley.

eps.t: Noggin and the Firecake - The Round Stones
eps.d: Nogbad the Bad finds the sorcerer's sword and threatens the kingdom with destruction.
